items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: I know him good as a book too.

ctx.x: And he was the highest paid musician around. Oh, my goodness.
That's funny, I can't think of who that Alto player, was he out in Los Angeles or something?
Uh, he went to Los Angeles after I went there. Uh, uh, I know him good as a book too. Yeah. Cause he and Louis was on some of Louis first recordings.
